label: Point of effort
text: ST.O.A4.2 — Concentration at the decisive point (M13) [clausewitz-c08], [suntzu-c07], [mao-c07], [advanced-c07]. Colonel Blotto: two players divide fixed budgets across battlefields, each won by the larger allocation; its mixed-strategy solution is owned by MA.B.C4 (91A). Centre of gravity (M27) [clausewitz-c11], [wylie-c16]; terrorism read through centre-of-gravity theory [wylie-c19]. Direct and indirect [suntzu-c06]; the indirect approach and its circularity [freedman-c11], [wylie-c13]. Victory as isolation of the insurgent [galula-c06]. Generic strategies and "stuck in the middle" [porter-c03], [porter-c04]. Chain-link systems [gsbs-c05].

warrant.standard: The claim holds across campaigns of differing type and era.
warrant.defeaters: Hindsight names the "decisive point"; narrative fallacy [taleb_bs-c05].
